sections.heading: About Us
sections.body: We bring together senior executives, innovators, and thought leaders from across the global media industry.
sections.extended: Our events offer space to catch up and expand your network. From relaxed breakfast briefings to evening receptions, exclusive screenings, talks, and panel discussions, each gathering brings together diverse perspectives and great company..

sections.heading: Upcoming Events
sections.description: Discover upcoming events bringing together senior leaders from across media, entertainment, and technology.
sections.note: Spaces are limited to keep events focused and conversational.

sections.heading: Supported by Our Partner Community
sections.description: Our events bring together organisations from across broadcasting, streaming, and media technology.

sections.heading: Join the Community
sections.body: Be part of a growing network of media leaders, innovators, and creatives. Our events are free, invite-only, and designed for great conversations.

sections.heading: New Here?
sections.body: If it’s your first time joining us, welcome. Our events bring together senior professionals from across media, entertainment, and technology in a relaxed setting designed for easy conversation. Expect a curated guest list, thoughtful formats, and plenty of time to connect with peers.

sections.heading: For Brands & Partners
sections.body: We also work with selected partners to create curated industry experiences.
